title: Funky lab 3 (source of the round-3 templates)
summary: The 8 comps the round-3 Funky templates were built and verified in: gig poster, menu special, new drop reveal, marquee bands, blob photo frame (mask window), party invite, countdown and zine quote.
use_when: You want to see a round-3 funky template working before using it, copy a comp's objects into a funky film, or re-extract a template with comp_to_template.py after changing its copy.

comps: FK Marquee bands (150 f, seamless scroll)
FK Blob frame (120 f, mask window)
FK Countdown (120 f, 4 beats of 30 f)

parameters: text content (sample copy: acts, dishes, names, dates and prices are invented)
the lists in funky_lab3.py (MQ, DETAILS, BEATS, ZINE, BLOB)
photo and product stand-ins (replace with real pictures)
carvercat_version: built and verified in Carvercat 0.1.6 (rev 1105,; public release binary, headless; pack added to the bundled Library for the test), 2026-10-28
copy_notes: No media; nothing to relink. Photos, the dish and the product are coloured stand-in shapes.
Each comp has a 'Lab bg' rectangle; templates are extracted with --drop "Lab bg".
Clip ids are unique per comp (fgp_, fmn_, fnd_, fmq_, fbf_, fpi_, fcd_, fzq_).

Rebuild: ai/scripts/motion/funky_lab3.py; every move is baked as keys, no presets to apply; open the file, run mask.make {ids:[window, content]} + parent.clear for the one MASKS pair (FK Blob frame), then edit.save.
Lint: every comp 0 errors / 0 warnings / 0 notes.
source: Carvercat team, built with an AI agent, 2026-10-28
